description: Catalog-family and entity-type routing hints derived from the adapters currently available in BankIntel-v2. These hints are routing preferences, not hard filters unless the user explicitly constrains a source.

fred.notes: FRED adapter contains market indices, rates, macro series, commodity references and direct series codes.

stocks.notes: Yahoo/stock adapter contains equity tickers and named listed companies.

commodities.notes: Commodity adapter contains commodity price series and aliases.

eurostat.notes: Eurostat adapter contains European statistical datasets and dimension-selectable tables, including banking-sector indicators such as bank profitability and capital ratios.

ecb2.notes: ECB adapter contains exchange rates, policy/market rates, HICP and banking series.

arad.notes: CNB ARAD adapter contains Czech central-bank, banking, macro and market datasets.

csu.notes: CZSO adapter contains Czech statistical tables and dimensions.

imf.notes: IMF adapter contains macro, government and financial-stability indicators.

bis.notes: BIS adapter contains banking, credit, exchange-rate and financial-market statistics.

oecd4.notes: OECD adapter contains economic outlook, prices, labour, sectoral, real-estate and commodity datasets.

data360.notes: Data360/World Bank style catalog contains broad macro, sectoral, commodity and market indicators.

worldbank.notes: World Bank catalog contains WDI and related development indicators.
